title: Pressure-control-solenoid current fault
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM recorded an electrical current-control problem involving the solenoid used to regulate transmission line pressure.
failureCriteria: Exact application-specific current-error criteria are not yet verified.

likelyCauses.cause: Poor contact at the PCM or transmission connector
Open, shorted, or high-resistance pressure-control-solenoid circuit
PCM driver fault after the circuit and solenoid test correctly

falsePositiveConditions: Connector resistance can produce a current error without proving the solenoid is mechanically defective.
confirmatoryTests: Compare commanded and reported pressure-control-solenoid current.
Check power, ground control, resistance, and connector condition under load.
Measure actual hydraulic line pressure separately if shift behavior is abnormal.
safetyLevel: Service soon; avoid diagnosis from this code alone
